prompt: Create a cinematic dark anime-style widescreen frame of a young woman with very long straight black hair and blunt bangs crouched or hunched forward in left profile, occupying the left third of the image, lighting a cigarette held near her lips. She has a moody punk look with subtle facial piercings, large hoop earrings, visible arm tattoos, long fingernails, and bare shoulders, rendered mostly as a deep blue-black silhouette with fine ink-like linework. Her cupped hands create a tiny warm orange-red ember glow at the cigarette tip, the only warm color in the scene. The background is filled with dense drifting smoke or fog, softly backlit in icy blue, fading from pale mist on the left to darker navy shadow on the right. Use a 2.35:1 cinematic aspect ratio, low-key lighting, grainy film texture, soft haze, atmospheric depth, strong silhouette, minimal detail in the face, and a melancholic nocturnal mood. Color palette: cobalt blue, midnight navy, cyan mist, black shadows, tiny ember orange. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一幅电影感暗黑动漫风格的宽银幕画面，主体为 一位留着超长直黑发和齐刘海的年轻女性，以左侧面姿态蹲伏或前倾，占据画面左侧三分之一，正点燃唇边的香烟。她呈现出一种忧郁的朋克风格，带有精致的面部穿孔、大圆环耳环、清晰可见的手臂纹身、长指甲和裸露的肩膀，整体渲染为深蓝黑色的剪影，辅以细腻的墨水质感线条。她合拢的双手在烟头处映出一抹微小的暖橙红色火光，这是场景中唯一的暖色调。背景充斥着浓郁的漂浮烟雾或迷雾，在冰蓝色的柔和背光下，从左侧的苍白薄雾渐变为右侧的深海军蓝阴影。采用 2.35:1 的电影画幅比例，低调照明，胶片颗粒质感，柔和朦胧感，氛围深度，强烈的剪影效果，面部细节极简，营造出忧郁的深夜氛围。调色盘：钴蓝色、午夜海军蓝、青色迷雾、黑色阴影、微小的余烬橙色。无文字，无水印，无额外角色。
